collection.title: Ford Escort Van 1990 to 2001 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Escort Van 1990 - 2001 model requires a 20" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook Arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
